name: project-memory
description: Durable project memory as markdown pages on disk. Search past decisions before guessing; record what the code cannot tell the next agent.

interface.shortDescription: Searchable project memory: why the code is the way it is
interface.longDescription: Keeps decisions, contracts and bug post-mortems as markdown pages in .memory/, searchable with BM25F ranking and no server. Reads before you explore an unfamiliar subsystem; writes after a non-obvious fix. Writes are validated rather than requested: a page with no sources, an unresolvable source path or a body too short to be worth keeping is rejected with the command to run instead.
defaultPrompt: Why is this part of the codebase built this way?
Remember why we made this decision.
